import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', n_colors=10)
bars = ax1.barh(breed_counts.index[::-1], breed_counts.values[::-1], color=colors[::-1])
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, breed_counts.values[::-1]):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:,}', 
             va='center', ha='left', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Dog Registrations by District (Kreis)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', n_colors=len(district_counts))
bars2 = ax2.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Total Registered Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Dog Registrations by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 3: Dog Age Distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
# Filter out invalid ages and get age distribution
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] >= 0) & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 20)]
sns.histplot(data=age_data, x='AlterVHundNum', bins=20, ax=ax3, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
ax3.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Dog Ages', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.axvline(age_data['AlterVHundNum'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, 
            label=f'Mean Age: {age_data["AlterVHundNum"].mean():.1f} years')
ax3.legend()

# Plot 4: Dog Gender Distribution with Owner Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create cross-tabulation of owner gender vs dog gender
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'])
gender_cross = gender_cross.reindex(columns=['männlich', 'weiblich'], fill_value=0)
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#4C72B0', '#DD8452'], edgecolor='white', width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', labels=['Male', 'Female'])
ax4.set_xticklabels(['Male Owner', 'Female Owner'], rotation=0)

# Add count labels on bars
for container in ax4.containers:
    ax4.bar_label(container, fmt='{:,.0f}', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
